scope: Mobile dashboard navigation and form submission
environment: Synthetic example · production build on localhost · Chrome mobile profile (390×844, 4× CPU)

flows.name: Switch between dashboard tabs
flows.conditions: Production build · mobile profile · warm server · same test account

flows.name: Open employee details
flows.conditions: Production build · mobile profile · warm server

flows.name: Submit administrative form
flows.conditions: Production build · mobile profile · isolated fixture database

findings.title: Eliminate sequential data fetching in tab navigation
findings.signal: Trace shows two independent server reads awaited one after the other on every tab switch.
findings.proposed_change: Start both reads after the authorization check and await them together.
findings.verification: Same journey and conditions, 7 runs each; typecheck, role tests and tab interaction tests pass.

findings.title: Remove repeated Prisma lookups from the details panel
findings.signal: Query log shows six identical SELECTs per panel open (5 of 5 runs).
findings.proposed_change: Load the panel data in one query and select only the fields the panel renders.

findings.title: Check Vercel function region against the Neon region
findings.signal: Server time is high on every request; region pairing not yet inspected.
findings.location: Vercel project settings · Neon project settings
findings.proposed_change: Compare both regions; propose a change only with measured round-trip evidence.
findings.requires_approval: Changing a function or database region is an infrastructure change.

findings.title: Virtualize the long client-side employee table
findings.signal: Expanding the list produces a 410 ms long animation frame dominated by layout (trace, 3 of 3 runs).
findings.proposed_change: Paginate on the server first; virtualize only if render cost remains high.

findings.title: Move the chart library out of the shared admin layout
findings.signal: A client component in the shared layout imports the chart library; route bundle size not yet measured.
findings.proposed_change: Measure the route bundle, then load the chart only where it is rendered.

findings.title: Avoid style recalculation on navigation hover
findings.signal: One trace shows extra style work on hover; not on any critical path.

findings.title: Remove a duplicate status request on back navigation
findings.signal: The same GET request fires twice when navigating back.
findings.proposed_change: Reuse the existing per-user request result.
findings.verification: Request count fell from 2 to 1 in 5 of 5 runs; navigation tests pass. Latency change not isolated.

coverage.note: Local production build only; no Vercel telemetry.
No read access to the shared database statistics.

limitations: Synthetic example: no repository, credentials, telemetry or customer data was used.
Findings can overlap; their gains must never be added together.
Region and bundle findings stay unverified until measured.
